verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own marketing says the platform can 'reimburse employees worldwide' alongside expense tracking, and it offers global transfers to 200+ countries at interbank rates. This suggests reimbursements abroad run on the same platform rather than a separate payments process. However, paying reimbursements in the employee's local currency is only implied by the general multi-currency payout features, not documented for reimbursements specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that reimbursements pay out in the employee's local currency, a description of the reimbursement workflow tying expense approval to the international payout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can reimburse employees abroad in their local currency without running a separate international payments process

citations.quote: Track card spending and reimburse employees worldwide
Make money transfers from the US to 200+ countries at interbank rates
Programmatically make cost effective, fast and secure global payouts
